title: Sucker Punch reportedly lays off 24 employees
excerpt: Game developer Sucker Punch has reportedly laid off 24 workers, shortly after releasing an expansion for Ghost of Yōtei.
body_html:
Game developer Sucker Punch has reportedly reduced its workforce by 24 employees. The reduction in staff comes just a few weeks after the studio successfully released a well-received expansion for its title, Ghost of Yōtei.

As the video game industry continues to face economic adjustments, this studio becomes the latest developer to experience staff cuts despite recent product releases. Further details regarding the specific departments affected by the 24 layoffs at Sucker Punch have not been detailed in the initial reports.
